choice.basis: The chart displays a downward trend in physicians per 1,000 residents from 2000 to 2017.5, with the value decreasing from approximately 1.75 to approximately 2.5. Since the y-axis increases downward, a lower position on the chart corresponds to a higher value. The final data point (2017.5) is at the bottom of the visible range, indicating the highest value in the period. This is a higher capacity pattern at the end of the period.
